plan.goal: Design a protein sequence that exhibits the desired activity and specificity. The presence of Mg(2+) is necessary for the protein to function in the desired environment. The AMP, (6S)-NADPHX binding site should be located in a region of the protein that is accessible to the ligand. The designed protein should have ATP binding, NADPHX epimerase activity, metal ion binding, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity to facilitate nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process. For general function, the protein needs to catalyze the epimerization of the S- and R-forms of NAD(P)HX, a damaged form of NAD(P)H that results from enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration. Use listed tools for the generation. Return an output protein sequence.
assumptions: Provider selected a workflow template that does not match the available request inputs; canonicalized to the validated local template.
